owner.title: Assistant Professor of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
owner.shortBio: My research focuses on CFD, aerospace engineering, and machine learning for interface dynamics.
extendedBio: Dr. Mohamed Kamra is an Assistant Professor of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at UAE University. His research focuses on computational fluid dynamics, multiphase flow, free-surface and interface dynamics, and the use of machine learning to improve numerical modeling workflows.

His work spans interface-capturing methods, volume-of-fluid modeling, sloshing and wave-impact problems, renewable energy systems, and aerospace applications. He combines physics-based simulation, experimental validation, and data-driven techniques to develop practical tools for complex engineering flows.

Alongside his research, he teaches and mentors students in mechanical and aerospace engineering, with an emphasis on connecting rigorous computational methods to real engineering design and analysis challenges.
